reasoning: CodexSessionScanner.swift:384-386 skips an event only when total_token_usage exists and is equal, across all five fields, to the previous total in the same file. previousTotal is local to scan(data:) and the memo always rescans a whole file, so no state carries over between files or across a partial read. A genuine turn always moves the running total, so it is never dropped. That includes a turn whose last_token_usage matches the previous one: the same_last_with_advanced_total_is_billed test covers it. Events with no total are kept. Reversal check: I removed the skip and got RED, 1200 vs 600 (and 800/400, 200/100). Minor note: total_token_usage is now decoded, so if one of its fields ever arrived as a non-integer, the whole line would count as a decodeFailure. Real payloads are integers, so this is not a blocker.
